verdict.rationale: Opting out of a product's own usage tracking is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about Elastic collecting usage data or offering a setting to disable it. Every mention of 'telemetry' refers to customer observability data being ingested (OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs), which is a different subject and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
